title: Warranted Reliance and Uncertainty in AI: reproducible experiments (Project 15)
description: Reproducible computational study of when calibrated AI confidence warrants reliance: decision costs and deferral, finite-sample uncertainty in reliability evidence, distribution shift and recalibration, and subgroup burdens under limited human review. Executed Kaggle notebook, 138-file results archive and reproducibility record. Project 15, Group 18.
